messages:
Noah Rivera: Quick follow-up from the all-hands: need clear dates for API surface changes, Console parity for Optimize, and the Dedicated rollback story.
Priya Desai: High level: API v2 rollout in phases — internal alpha ~9 days, partner canary ~3 weeks, public beta ~6 weeks after canary, GA ~12 weeks if stable.
Elena Patel: Console -> parity: core Optimize controls in beta during partner canary. Advanced tuning (quantization suggestions, per-model presets) behind flags, unlocked during beta expansion.
Omar Haddad: What does "partner canary" mean operationally? Specific tenants or % traffic?
Priya Desai: Partner canary = invited customers + internal traffic, roughly 3-6% of traffic. We'll pick 2-4 partners covering low-latency & high-throughput use cases.
Lena Ruiz: Rollback plan? If latency spikes, what happens to Dedicated tenants?
Elena Patel: Automated rollback steers traffic back to prior runtime variant, KV cache flush for affected nodes, and we can disable batching per-model at runtime. Dedicated pools are untouched unless partners explicitly opt-in.
release-bot: Build 2026-03-23-rc5 promoted to staging at 1905556700.
Noah Rivera: Docs and SDK: will there be a same-day docs + SDK patch? Need migration bullets for partners.
Priya Desai: Yes 0 docs refresh + non-breaking SDK patch on public beta day. We'll publish migration checklist and short code samples with p60/p95 numbers.
Omar Haddad: Ops request: timing for the canary region and monitoring window?
Elena Patel: Canary starts in us-west2 for 72h observation, then expand to us-east1 + eu-west1 if stable. We'll have a dedicated incident channel and 24/7 oncall for the first expansion.
Lena Ruiz: Please share exact feature-flag names and dashboard JSON so support can prep.
Priya Desai: Will drop flag names, partner list, and dashboard snippet to the release plan doc by EOD.
Noah Rivera: Thanks all. I'll assemble a one-slide exec summary for partner sync and send draft. Close thread here.
